about: Which course unit receives each curated exwb block (ROADMAP P9-T6). Keys are curated file stems in exwb/curated/. Davidson's exercises are cumulative, so a block goes to the unit that teaches its topic, moved later when that unit comes before material the sentences rely on. Held blocks (exwb/EXEMPTIONS.md) are not listed and are not emitted.
